en-US.description: The pattern matching swiss knife for malware researchers (and everyone else)
en-US.longDescription: YARA is a tool aimed at (but not limited to) helping malware researchers to identify and classify malware samples. With YARA you can create descriptions of malware families (or whatever you want to describe) based on textual or binary patterns. Each description, a.k.a rule, consists of a set of strings and a boolean expression which determine its logic.
en-US.name: YARA
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Add yr_get_version to report the version of the library loaded at runtime (#2247).
- Expose nine more e_machine values in elf module (#2248).
- Sync yara man page with current CLI options (#2256).
- BUGFIX: Validate string, rule, and namespace indices in yr_rules_from_arena (c19fa616).
- BUGFIX: Fix C-stack overflow on deeply nested regex and hex string ASTs (034623f5).
- BUGFIX: Fix integer overflow in console.log() string escaping (6de23b4f).
- BUGFIX: Fix integer overflows in ELF symbol lowercasing and SIMPLE_STR (49088776).
- BUGFIX: Fix 32-bit integer overflow when allocating the VM stack (3aa7cd10).
- BUGFIX: Fix 32-bit integer overflow in _yr_compiler_default_include_callback (b325745a).
- BUGFIX: Fix integer overflow and unchecked allocation in Authenticode digest formatting (5fb6a209).
- BUGFIX: Fix VM stack corruption when a disabled rule is used inside a rule set (6e6f9968).
- BUGFIX: Harden regex anchor and match bounds checks and allow nullable repeats in _yr_re_fiber_sync (9f881b2a).
- BUGFIX: Fix 32-bit match length truncation and notebook allocation overflow on chained strings (0bf3faf2).
- BUGFIX: Fix infinite loop and fiber exhaustion on repeated zero-width assertions in regexes (f8e1ca2e).
- BUGFIX: Prevent exponential memory and CPU growth on nested {n} regex repeats (c1e0dff9).
- BUGFIX: Fix infinite loop/abort when compiling + regex quantifier over zero-code nodes (1cf79dd0).
- BUGFIX: Validate compiled-rule external variables (#2244).
- BUGFIX: Reset entrypoint in yr_scanner_clean_matches (#2245).
- BUGFIX: Fix misaligned uint32_t load of map_list.size in dex module (#2249).
- BUGFIX: Request MD5 with -fips on OpenSSL 3 and handle failure in hash, pe, and elf modules (#2252).
- BUGFIX: Enforce arena buffer bounds invariant in every build (#2253).
- BUGFIX: Harden Authenticode parsing against malformed data (a37be989).
- BUGFIX: Validate arena buffer count (0cdff367).
- BUGFIX: Reject hex jump and repeat lengths that overflow an int (#2237).
- BUGFIX: Bound Aho-Corasick state and match indices on load (#2241).
- BUGFIX: Guard repeat-end against empty stack in _yr_re_fiber_sync (#2240).
- BUGFIX: Bound jump target within code section in yr_execute_code (#2236).
- BUGFIX: Reject unknown object type in yr_object_create (#2235).
- BUGFIX: Check stored digest length before comparing Authenticode digests (#2234).
Contributors: @0xdeadbab3 @dev-rehaann @Henglie @jmestwa-coder @M0nd0R @MarkAtwood @MRX-72 @munzzyy @Rakesh717 @wxsBSD, Hongduo Zhao, Ada Logics, and Anthropic

zh-CN.description: 恶意软件研究人员（以及任何人）的模式匹配瑞士刀
zh-CN.longDescription: YARA 是一款旨在（但不限于）帮助恶意软件研究人员识别和分类恶意软件样本的工具。使用 YARA，您可以根据文本或二进制模式创建恶意软件家族（或您想描述的任何东西）的描述。每个描述（又称规则）都由一组字符串和一个布尔表达式组成，它们决定了描述的逻辑。
zh-CN.name: YARA
